visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short dark hair and bangs, wearing a pink ribbed t-shirt, sits on a person's lap in a bright indoor room. She smiles broadly with her mouth open, showing her teeth. In the background, another young child in a beige romper walks past a wooden table. (2) The toddler crosses her arms over her chest, furrowing her brow and pouting slightly to mimic an "angry" expression. An adult in a light blue t-shirt walks behind her in the background of the living area, while the setting remains bright. (3) The scene shifts as the toddler opens her mouth very wide, laughing energetically. Her eyes squint as she exhibits high-energy joy. The lighting is bright and natural, likely coming from a large window in the background of the domestic space. (4) She looks down with a somber face, then uses both hands to rub her eyes, mimicking crying. She peeks through her fingers while maintaining a playful demeanor. Yellow and white variety text overlays appear on the screen to narrate her actions. (5) The girl looks at the camera, then places her fist to her nose, extending her arm to imitate an elephant's trunk. She smiles and looks towards an off-camera adult who is speaking to her, showing small hand gestures. (6) Close-up view of the toddler's face as she maintains the elephant trunk gesture. She glances to the side with a mischievous look. The background shows bookshelves filled with books and a clean white door frame in the hallway. (7) She throws her head back and laughs heartily, covering her mouth with both hands in a shy but amused gesture. She then looks directly into the lens with a wide, toothy grin and bright, expressive eyes during the phase. (8) The toddler uses her index fingers to poke and push in her cheeks, creating a "pouty" or "cute" face. She stares intently at the camera, holding the pose for a few seconds as she is prompted by the adult. (9) She leans forward and wraps her arms around the adult who is holding her, burying her face in their shoulder for a hug. The camera angle is slightly tilted downwards as the toddler exhibits a warm and affectionate posture. (10) A bright pink outro screen is displayed, featuring a centered cartoon illustration of the young girl toddler sitting cross-legged while holding a snack. Below the graphic, the text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" appears in a clean, white sans-serif font against the solid background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An adult female voice prompts with the word "生氣" (angry) in a gentle, melodic tone. A light, acoustic BGM with a soft guitar and piano melody plays at a low volume. The toddler makes a short, breathy vocalization in response to the prompter. (2) The adult says "開心" (happy). Immediately, the toddler emits a high-pitched, loud laugh with high arousal and excitement. The BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo of approximately 105 BPM throughout this phase, blending well with the laughter. (3) Following the prompt "難過" (sad), the toddler's vocal intensity drops significantly, producing soft, muffled pouting sounds. The background ambient noise is a clean indoor room tone, allowing for high harmonic clarity of the child's soft vocal textures. (4) The adult prompts "哭哭" (cry). The toddler performs a rhythmic, fake crying vocalization "uh-uh-uh" with moderate pitch variability and intentional phrasing. There's a slight rustling sound of clothing as she moves, but the SNR remains high and clear. (5) Multiple female voices are heard in conversation. One asks "還有什麼?" (what else?). The toddler responds clearly with "大象" (elephant) in a high-pitched voice. Another adult laughs softly in the background, creating a warm and social domestic acoustic environment. (6) A brief period of vocal silence occurs, filled by the toddler's soft snorting or rhythmic breathing sounds as she imitates an elephant's trunk blowing. The BGM remains a constant, light-hearted rhythmic bed with acoustic guitar strums providing a steady harmonic foundation. (7) The adult prompts "猩猩" (gorilla) and asks the child for a laugh. The toddler breaks into a sequence of loud, staccato laughs with high energy and positive valence. The articulation is clear, joyous, and dominates the audio mix during this segment. (8) The adult asks "這是什麼? 嘟嘟嘴?". The toddler makes a distinct, percussive lip-smacking or sucking sound indicating a kiss. The BGM starts a slow, gradual fade-out towards the end of this phase as the playful performance session reaches its natural conclusion. (9) The adult says "抱抱" (hug). The toddler repeats "抱抱" with a soft, affectionate tone and lower volume. The sounds of shifting fabric and muffled thuds are audible as they embrace, signaling the end of the expressive activity in the recording. (10) The BGM concludes with a final cheerful major chord. A high-pitched, synthesized animal-like sound effect or "meow" occurs right at the very end as the audio track cuts to silence, marking the transition to the pink outro graphic screen.
